description: Full body figure of a Malaysian man in his late 30s. He is wearing a crisp, professional Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) dark blue uniform with silver badges on the chest and shoulder epaulettes. He has short, neat black hair and is standing in a tall, authoritative posture. He wears polished black boots.

Full body figure of a middle-aged Malaysian Chinese woman in her 50s. She is wearing a professional blouse and tailored trousers, suitable for office wear, in a muted color palette. She has black hair styled in a practical short bob. She is wearing simple flat sandals and a small gold watch.

Full body anonymous human figure, featureless silhouette. The figure is a glowing digital cyan outline with no facial features, wearing a stylized suit made of binary code patterns to represent a digital entity.

Full body anonymous human figure, featureless silhouette. The figure has a matte black void-like appearance with glowing white circuits running across the torso and limbs, wearing a sharp-edged geometric cloak that mimics a formal legal robe.
